messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment notice: rolling out sdk@2.1.0 (streaming protocol v2) to production canary (5%) at 2024-05-06T15:20Z

juno (customer-success): getting a ping — several customers reporting dropped streaming connections since ~15:22Z

support-bot: alert: 3 customers with active incidents: Acme Corp, BrightWave, Zeno. Error rate spike on /v1/stream: 18% -> 42% (15:23)

kai (oncall): I'm on it. Paging infra team. Meena, can you take logs? I'll check canary.

meena (sre): looking. KV cache errors + handshake failures in logs:
```
2024-05-06T15:23:11Z ERROR stream_session: handshake_error: unsupported_frame_type
2024-05-06T15:23:14Z WARN conn: client_disconnect: code=1006
```

eli (eng-release): Reproducer locally with sdk@2.1.0 + python client shows incoming frames being reinterpreted; likely breaking change in streaming wire protocol. This was supposed to be backward compatible — investigating. @kai

kai (oncall): Can we kill the feature flag for SDK rolling users? We used feature flag `sdk_streaming_v2` to gate rollouts.

eli (eng-release): Executing kill-switch now:
```
redwood-cli flags disable sdk_streaming_v2 --env=prod
```

deploy-bot: Flag `sdk_streaming_v2` disabled in prod (targeted rollout paused) — 15:28:04Z :warning:

support-bot: Error rate dropped to 12% (15:31). Some clients still failing; likely sessions opened before flag flip.

kai (oncall): Initiating rollback of server-side routing to sdk_v1 compatibility. Meena, coordinate with infra to rollback canary.

meena (sre): Rolling back canary pods:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/llm-inference --namespace=prod --to-revision=2024050608
```

eli (eng-release): Pushing hotfix patch to release branch to ensure sdk@2.1.0 is not advertised in registry; tagging 2.1.0 as 'broken' and publishing 2.1.1 with protocol fix.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated at 15:34:10Z. Canary error rate now 5%.

juno (customer-success): Notifying impacted customers: Acme, BrightWave, Zeno. Drafted message to customers explaining temporary streaming disruption and that rollback is in progress.

support-bot: Customer-facing status updated: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/streaming-protocol-20240506

kai (oncall): Assigning incident lead to eli, documenting impact and severity. Current assessment: ~3% of sessions failed for ~2k customers, primary impact: streaming clients using sdk@2.1.0. Severity: Sev2.

eli (eng-release): Confirming fix pushed. Publishing 2.1.1 with corrected frame header handling. CI green. Recommend retracting 2.1.0 and creating migration guide for SDK users.

meena (sre): Post-rollback metrics: total error rate back to baseline (1.3%). Rolling window shows cleanup of existing bad sessions over next 20 minutes.

kai (oncall): Handoff to meena for monitoring for next 4 hours. I'll update incident tracker and start postmortem draft. @eli please add root cause and remediation steps.

eli (eng-release): Root cause: unintentional change to streaming frame encoding during refactor (binary/int packing mismatch). Remediation: add protocol contract test and canary synthetic test that mimics older clients.

juno (customer-success): Customers acknowledged update, one asked for ETA to fully restore long-lived sessions. We suggest restart clients. We'll follow-up once we confirm 2.1.1 rollout.

support-bot: Incident closed to active mitigation at 16:05Z — monitoring continues. Created ticket RED-2024-435 for postmortem.

kai (oncall): Closing thread. Good work. Action items: eli: PR for contract tests, meena: add enhanced alert for streaming handshake errors, juno: follow up with top impacted customers.
